rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for thinking of Halcyon Threshold — and for coming to the meetup. I'm not in a position to give an on-the-record quote right now, but I appreciate you asking. Happy to reconnect down the line if the piece (or a future one) is still relevant. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Reporter (Larkin Dispatch) asking for a named quote by tomorrow noon — sent a polite decline.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Hi, Thanks for including Halcyon Threshold in this. I'm not able to sign on as a named, published signatory at this time, but I appreciate the work the Corvid Institute is doing here and will keep an eye on it for the future. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Corvid Institute's open-letter sign-on (would've published your name + affiliation to press by Wednesday) — sent a polite decline.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Really glad you reached out — thank you. Halcyon Threshold is still early days, so I want to point you at something concrete rather than vague. Here's something genuinely useful for someone with your skills: a landscape scan. There's a scattered set of opportunities right now (rapid grant rounds, compute-credit programs, open calls for write-ups, public comment periods) and I don't yet have a clean picture of who funds what, what the actual bar is, and what's time-sensitive. If you're willing, a simple spreadsheet — organization, program, typical award/amount, deadline, eligibility, link, and a one-line \"why it might fit Halcyon Threshold\" — would save me a lot of time and help me decide where to focus. No pressure on scope; even a first pass on 5-10 programs over the next couple weeks would help a lot. If that doesn't appeal, I'm also open to other ideas if something else looks more interesting to you. Thanks again, Morgan"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya Raman (offered help) with a concrete, bounded task: building a landscape map of grant/compute/comment-period deadlines and fit.
